sentence: This project studies polluted white dwarfs to learn about the compositions and motions of planetary systems.
This project adds soft skills such as communication and teamwork to cybersecurity courses through team-based activities and simulations.
This project studies the computational complexity of certain problems in quantum algebra and topology.
This project builds a compiler that handles qubit placement, gate scheduling and atom movement for dynamically reconfigurable atom arrays.
This project studies how lions live in groups in a semi-arid environment and what ecological factors drive their social behavior.
This project studies how raindrops form and change in size in warm rain clouds, using radar and ground instruments.
This project studies why the observable universe holds more matter than antimatter, using theoretical models of particle physics.
This project studies how the immune system recognizes viruses when proteins and antibodies attach to them.
This project builds a research network that studies how land, water and people can keep grassland ecosystems resilient.
This project upgrades the storage of animal tissue samples to freezers that use liquid nitrogen.
This project builds open-source software that predicts how molecules in polymers and other complex fluids organize.
This project uses DNA sequencing to work out the relationships among bees and how their use of host plants evolved.
This project develops a way to make phages outside the cell using cell-free synthesis.
This project tests a three-week classroom unit that uses a shaft loom and a conversational agent to explain how machine learning works.
This project studies what phases and structures Bismuth forms at an interface with 2D materials.
